newsitem.title: USA: PRI Auto stock drops after Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: PRI Auto stock drops after Q4 results.

text.p: PRI Automation Inc's stock price fell 5-1/4 to 33-1/4 on Friday after the company reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.49 a share, one cent below analysts' consensus estimate.

"We were off a penny from the consensus," said Charlene Sullivan, an aide to the chief financial officer of the Bellirica, Mass.-based maker of factory automation systems for semiconductor makers. "They were predicting $0.50 a share; we reported $0.49 a share."
PRI corporate officers could not be reached for comment.
